title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: Your new order folded last week's items into this week's; nine groups nothing in it covers come back to you, as it said. Keep the seven marked keep and drop the two marked drop?
sections.recommendation: Yes: the seven kept stay on the list for their phase and cost nothing this week; the two dropped are housekeeping nobody needs. The nine are under Read it here.
detail: The nine groups (keep or drop, my recommendation)
1. The studies' advice for phases 3 to 10 (92 lines): keep, read when each phase is planned.
2. The town's simulation in the game (the fallback work) and its two faults: keep.
3. Two canon questions for you: the town's 29 small inventions, and Mickey's past, which disagrees with itself: keep, asked when the story work starts.
4. The first 30 minutes' three choices (why Tom mends Rita's window, what fills the quiet): keep for phase 3.
5. The sound listening list (needs your ear: the day's background, the radio, a possible whine): keep for phase 2's sound.
6. Three voices: the dispatcher's voice, the flat delivery of prepared lines, crowd lines drifting American: keep.
7. Three code libraries in the game whose licences are not yet read: keep (must be settled before a copy leaves your PC).
8. Your old archive repository's two settings (keep its files 3 days, switch its Actions off): drop; it costs nothing as it is.
9. Old launcher files that name retired things: drop; nothing that ships uses them.
